actions.similar: pushing (differs: partner only steps back and stays standing); falling_down (differs: one person falls with no second person causing it); kicking (differs: actor's leg swings into the partner, who usually stays upright)

actions.name: grab_stuff
actions.motion: The partner holds the hands in front of the body. The actor reaches the right arm quickly toward the partner's hands and then pulls it back sharply toward the actor's own torso. The partner's hands are pulled forward briefly and may then reach after the actor or pull back.

phases.start: partner holds hands in front, actor reaches
phases.middle: actor's hand grips and pulls back sharply
phases.end: actor holds the hand near the body, partner reacts

actions.similar: giving_object (differs: hands move slowly and the partner offers with the arm extended); exchange_things (differs: both people pass hands both ways calmly); shaking_hands (differs: hands join and move up and down instead of being pulled away)

actions.name: shoot_with_gun
actions.motion: The actor raises the right arm, often supported by the left hand, until it points straight at the partner, and holds it still with small backward jerks. The partner reacts by raising both hands, flinching, falling, or turning away. The actor's arm stays aimed for a while before lowering.

phases.start: actor lifts the arm toward the partner
phases.middle: arm held straight and aimed with small recoil jerks, partner reacts
phases.end: actor lowers the arm, partner has raised hands or fallen

actions.similar: point_finger (differs: arm points but there is no recoil and the partner shows little reaction); capitulate (differs: a single person raises both hands with no one aiming); wield_knife (differs: arm thrusts repeatedly rather than being held still)

actions.name: step_on_foot
actions.motion: The actor stands near the partner, lifts the right knee, and brings the foot down hard onto the partner's foot. The partner may lift that foot, bend forward, or step back. The actor then moves the foot away and stands normally.

phases.start: actor lifts a foot near the partner
phases.middle: foot stamps onto the partner's foot, partner flinches

actions.similar: kicking (differs: leg swings forward into the partner's body); walking_towards (differs: both people step normally toward each other without a stamp); follow (differs: one walks behind the other with no stamping step)

actions.name: high-five
actions.motion: Both people face each other and each raises one arm so the hand is at or above head height. The hands swing toward each other and meet briefly between the two people, then pull back. Both arms then lower while the torsos stay upright.

phases.start: both raise a hand
phases.middle: hands meet between them above the shoulders

actions.similar: shaking_hands (differs: hands meet at waist height and stay joined, moving up and down); cheers_and_drink (differs: hands meet at chest height and then go to the mouth); hand_waving (differs: one person waves a hand side to side with no contact)

actions.name: cheers_and_drink
actions.motion: Both people face each other and each extends the right hand forward at chest height until the hands meet briefly in the middle. Each person then pulls the hand back to the mouth, tilting the head slightly back while the hand stays there. The hands lower at the end.

phases.start: both raise hands toward each other
phases.middle: hands meet briefly between them
phases.end: each hand moves to the mouth and the head tilts back

actions.similar: drink_water (differs: one person brings a hand to the mouth with no partner contact); high-five (differs: hands meet overhead and then lower without going to the mouth); giving_object (differs: one hand passes forward to the other with no hand going to the mouth)

actions.name: carry_object
actions.motion: Both people bend slightly and place their hands at waist or hip height facing each other, then straighten up together. They walk in the same direction, keeping a steady distance apart with their arms held forward or downward toward a shared point. At the end they bend and lower their hands together.

phases.start: both bend and grip low
phases.middle: walk together keeping hands at the same height
phases.end: both lower their hands and release

actions.similar: walking_towards (differs: people move toward each other rather than together); follow (differs: one walks behind the other with arms swinging freely); move_heavy_objects (differs: a single person moves something low without a partner)

actions.name: take_a_photo
actions.motion: The actor stands facing the partner at a distance and raises both hands to the front of the face or chest, holding them still and close together. The partner stands still, sometimes posing with an arm raised. The actor may step slightly to adjust and then lowers the hands.

phases.start: actor raises hands to face level
phases.middle: hands held still, partner poses

actions.similar: taking_a_selfie (differs: one person holds a hand up in front facing themselves); shoot_with_gun (differs: one arm extended straight toward the partner); point_finger (differs: one arm extended toward the partner, not both hands at the face)

actions.name: follow
actions.motion: Both people walk with alternating leg steps and natural arm swings. One person leads and the other walks behind, facing the leader's back and keeping a similar distance. Both move in the same direction until they stop.

phases.start: leader starts walking with the follower behind
phases.middle: both walk in the same direction one behind the other

actions.similar: walking_towards (differs: people walk facing each other and approach); walking_apart (differs: people walk away from each other in opposite directions); carry_object (differs: both walk with arms held toward each other at a shared point)

actions.name: whisper
actions.motion: The actor steps close to the partner and leans the torso and head sideways toward the partner's head. The right hand rises to the side of the actor's mouth and stays there. The partner keeps still or tilts the head toward the actor, then they separate.

phases.start: actor approaches and leans in
phases.middle: head next to the partner's head with hand at the mouth

actions.similar: hugging (differs: arms wrap around the partner's body); hush (differs: one person holds a hand at their own lips with no partner nearby); pat_on_back (differs: hand moves on the partner's back rather than near the mouth)

actions.name: exchange_things
actions.motion: Both people face each other and extend their arms forward so their hands meet in the space between them. Each person both offers with one hand and takes with the other, so the hands cross over or meet twice. Both then pull their hands back to their own bodies.

phases.start: both reach forward
phases.middle: hands meet in the middle to swap

actions.similar: giving_object (differs: only one person extends a hand to give and the other just receives); shaking_hands (differs: hands clasp and move up and down); grab_stuff (differs: one person reaches quickly and pulls sharply away)

actions.name: support_somebody
actions.motion: The partner stands or walks with a bent, unsteady posture, with one arm placed over the actor's shoulders. The actor stands close at the side, with one arm around the partner's back or waist and the other holding the partner's arm. They walk slowly together with small, uneven steps.

phases.start: actor moves beside the partner and puts an arm around
phases.middle: both walk slowly with the partner leaning on the actor
phases.end: they stop or the partner stands steady

actions.similar: hugging (differs: people face each other and wrap arms without walking); carry_object (differs: both walk apart with arms held forward); staggering (differs: one person walks unsteadily without anyone supporting)

actions.name: rock-paper-scissors
actions.motion: Both people face each other and raise the right hand in front of the chest. Both hands move up and down together in short beats, usually three times, then stop extended forward between them. They may repeat the round, sometimes with one person raising a hand after winning.

phases.start: both raise a hand in front
phases.middle: hands bounce together in rhythm

actions.similar: shaking_hands (differs: hands clasp together and move as one); shake_fist (differs: a single person shakes a raised hand alone); high-five (differs: hands meet overhead with contact)
